_comment: Per camera and direction: which measure of the demand settings drives which SUMO edges. Edges are copied from camera_segments.json (build_demand.py checks they match). fullframe_5050: full-frame rate x 0.5 per direction (legacy). directional_roi: ROI rate (FORWARD/REVERSE) x 1.0 per edge. source_index = index into camera_segments.json directions.

caveats: direction split is the inherited unverified 50/50 assumption
beta calibrated on full-frame counts; transfer to ROI counts is unvalidated
one ROI rate is applied to each edge of the two-edge chain LTK J0-J1-J2 (inherited network-model assumption, not two independent observations)
